description: This file contains utility functions for handling scrollbar behavior in a Compose UI, including interpolating item indices for smooth scrolling and calculating item visibility percentage.

methods.name: interpolateFirstItemIndex
methods.description: Calculates a smoothly interpolated index for the first visible item in a lazy list for scrollbar positioning.

methods.name: itemVisibilityPercentage
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of an item visible within the viewport.
